messages:
Meera Patel: OmniPay just escalated — after last night's rollout customers are seeing invented fees and dropped line items in invoice summaries. Reported failure rate ~30% on their test suite. P1.
Meera Patel: Example input + response from OmniPay (req-id: req-0a3b2c):
```
POST /v1/generate
{"prompt":"Summarize invoice #1245: items, totals, taxes","customer_id":"omnipay"}
===>
{"summary":"Invoice 1245: service fee $12, handling $3, total $115.00"}
```
Meera Patel: Customer says handling fee and service fee are not present on the source PDF. They also lost line item for subscription.
Sam Irving: Oncall — pulling logs for req-0a3b2c. Can you share the exact prompt + any sample PDFs? Also which model was in prod at time?
Meera Patel: Deploy logs show rollout at 1890123000: rwd-gen-v3.0.0 (int8 quantized build). Canary 10% -> 100% by 02:30 UTC. I attached their minimal repro PDF in the ticket.
Jordi Torres: That timing matches an optimization change we merged (quant kernel switch: aten->fused-kernel-int8). Could be a numerics/regression for numeric extraction.
Jordi Torres: Quick diff of model config on prod:
- previous: rwd-gen-v2.9.7 (fp16, kv-cache-optim)
- current: rwd-gen-v3.0.0 (int8, fused-attn, kernel-v2)
Alyssa Chen: If this is causing customer-facing hallucinations we should either pin OmniPay to the prior variant or roll back the global rollout. What's faster?
Sam Irving: Easiest immediate mitigation: route OmniPay to rwd-gen-v2.9.7 while we triage. I can push a routing override in <10m.
Meera Patel: I'll notify OmniPay support we have a mitigation plan.
Jordi Torres: I can reproduce the bad summary locally when using the int8 kernels. FP16 outputs look correct. Suspect quantization + fused-attn edge-case for numeric context.
Meera Patel: Can we do an org-wide rollback if multiple customers affected? For now only OmniPay reported this P1.
Alyssa Chen: Keep global rollback as option if more reports come in but prioritize per-customer pinning. CSM needs ETA for fix.
Sam Irving: Executing routing override now.
infra-bot: Command accepted: set-routing --selector customer=omnipay --model=rwd-gen-v2.9.7 --reason "urgent output-regression"
deploy-bot: Rollout status: override applied to customer=omnipay -> routing now v2.9.7 (propagation expected <60s).
Sam Irving: Verify: ran the exact request against pinned route, got summary matching ground truth. Req-id: req-0a3b2c-verify.
Meera Patel: OmniPay confirms initial verification shows corrected summaries on their 10-sample set. They're asking for a wider validation (50 docs) and a timeline for permanent fix.
Jordi Torres: I'll open a bug and start bisecting the kernel change. Plan: repro -> isolate fused-attn change -> run with int8-disabled build -> if passes, revert fused-attn for int8 release.
Jordi Torres: Quick local note: disabling fused-attn removes hallucination in numeric spans, so fix is targeted to kernel math adjustments.
Alyssa Chen: Great, please add severity, customer impact, and owner for the postmortem. Notify legal/CS for SLA comms.
Meera Patel: Confirmed OmniPay ETA to them: we'll maintain pinned route and follow up with timeline within 24 hours. Marking P1 until fix lands.
Jordi Torres: I'll cut a diagnostic branch and post logs + PR link in this thread when ready.
Sam Irving: Once Jordi posts the PR, I'll coordinate a staged deploy (canary + smoke) with rollback ready.
Meera Patel: Customer happy for now. I'll keep them updated and close the support ticket once we release a non-regressed build.
Alyssa Chen: Thanks team — swift response. :thumbsup: 
Meera Patel: Adding note: create incident ticket in tracker, assign to Jordi, tag priority=customer-impact.
Jordi Torres: On it.
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-omnipay-output-regression.
Meera Patel: Leaving this thread open for logs/PRs.
Jordi Torres: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1789 — contains kernel numeric guard and test vectors.
Sam Irving: Scheduling canary tomorrow 04:00 UTC with smoke tests against OmniPay sample set first.
Meera Patel: Closing loop with OmniPay and legal after canary passes.
Alyssa Chen: Nice work, everyone.
